title: T‑Mobile Fiber Unveils Its Fastest Plan Yet — 5 Gig with a 10-year Price Guarantee
summary: At just $90/month, the new 5 Gig plan delivers the speed and capacity to keep up as households’ internet needs grow, with a price guaranteed for a decade
body_markdown:
**BELLEVUE, Wash. — November 2, 2026** — T‑Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS) today announced T‑Mobile Fiber is launching its fastest plan yet, bringing customers 5 Gig fiber internet backed by a 10-year price guarantee. Built for busy, connected households, 5 Gig is made to keep up when everyone — and everything — is online at once, with an internet price customers can count on for a decade. The Fiber 5 Gig plan is available starting tomorrow, November 3, for $90 a month with AutoPay, plus taxes and fees.


While some internet providers still draw customers in with low introductory prices, only to automatically raise their rates when the promotion ends, T‑Mobile Fiber does things differently. Customers who sign up for 5 Gig get the regular rate from day one with a 10-year price guarantee, locking in the price of their internet data for a full decade from the time they signed up.


“Think about how much more we’re asking our internet to handle today than just a few years ago. Between online gaming, smart devices and AI-powered tools, there’s more happening online in our households than ever,” said Andre Almeida, Chief Commercial Officer, T Mobile. “Our fastest 5 Gig plan gives customers incredible capacity for everything they’re doing today, with room to grow for whatever comes next. And with a 10-year price guarantee, customers get peace of mind knowing the price of their internet won’t change for years to come.”


**More Speed, More Choice**
With 5 Gig, busy households have the bandwidth for more people and devices to be online at the same time — whether that’s gaming, working or keeping a growing number of smart home devices connected. And because T‑Mobile Fiber runs on a 100% fiber-optic connection directly to the home, customers get fast, consistent performance with symmetrical speeds, meaning uploads are just as fast as downloads. That matters because households aren’t just downloading. Video calls, security cameras, cloud backups and more depend on fast upload speeds, too.


The value also extends beyond speed. Customers don’t need to bundle with a wireless plan to get T‑Mobile Fiber’s best pricing, and every T‑Mobile Fiber plan includes a Wi-Fi router with no monthly equipment fees, professional installation at no extra cost, unlimited data with no caps and no annual contract. Customers also get access to[T‑Mobile Tuesdays](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/t-mobile-tuesdays) , a weekly perks program with savings on dining, gas, entertainment and more.


Here’s a look at the expanded lineup, with the following pricing and limited-time offers available in select locations starting November 3. Check[Fiber.T‑Mobile.com](https://www.t-mobile.com/home-internet/fiber) for specific availability, offer and pricing details.


- **Fiber 300** — A reliable option for everyday internet activities like working from home, streaming and connecting smart devices. For a limited time, get Fiber 300 for $35/month with AutoPay plus taxes and fees — a $10/month savings.
- **Fiber 1 Gig** — A step up for busy households where multiple people are streaming, video calling and working online at the same time. Includes a mesh Wi-Fi extender for households that need it. For a limited time, get Fiber 1 Gig for $55/month with AutoPay plus taxes and fees — a $5/month savings, plus one month free via bill credit and a $100 virtual prepaid card within 14 weeks.
- **Fiber 2 Gig** — Built for high-demand households juggling online gaming, 4K streaming and other bandwidth-intensive activities across multiple devices. Includes a mesh Wi-Fi extender for households that need it. Get Fiber 2 Gig for $70/month with AutoPay plus taxes and fees, and for a limited time get one month free via bill credit and $300 in virtual prepaid cards within 14 weeks.
- **Fiber 5 Gig** — T‑Mobile Fiber’s fastest plan yet, built for the most connected households with the speed to handle today’s demands and plenty of capacity to keep up as internet needs grow. Comes with a 10-year price guarantee and a mesh Wi-Fi extender for households that need it. Get Fiber 5 Gig for $90/month with AutoPay plus taxes and fees, and for a limited time get two months free via two bill credits and $300 in virtual prepaid cards within 14 weeks.


**Get More with T‑Mobile**
Great home internet is just the start of what T‑Mobile has to offer. Customers who also have their wireless service with T‑Mobile get even more value.[T-Mix](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/un-carrier/t-mobile-introduces-tmix) , an industry-first approach to wireless, available starting in November, lets customers choose which benefits are included in their plans. This includes the widest range of benefits that can be included in a wireless plan across streaming, music, gaming, food delivery, travel and more — with the ability to change their mix as their needs change. That’s on top of the member perks T‑Mobile members get from Day 1, including exclusive hotel and rental car benefits, a[Delta premium in-flight drink On Us](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/travel) ,[MLB.TV On Us](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/mlbtv) , and savings and free stuff every week through[T‑Mobile Tuesdays](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/t-mobile-tuesdays) .


T‑Mobile Fiber’s new 5 Gig plan is available starting November 3. To learn more, check availability and sign up, visit[Fiber.T‑Mobile.com](https://www.t-mobile.com/home-internet/fiber) .


Follow the T‑Mobile Newsroom on[X](https://x.com/tmobilenews) and[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/tmobilenews/) to catch the latest company updates.


# # #


**10-year Price Guarantee:** Taxes & fees, voluntary equipment or speed upgrades, select limited-time promotions, per-use charges, third-party services, and network management practices aren’t included.


**About T‑Mobile**
As the supercharged Un-carrier, T‑Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS) is powered by an award-winning nationwide 5G Advanced network that connects more people, in more places, than ever before. With T‑Mobile’s unique value proposition of best network, best value and best experiences, the Un-carrier is redefining connectivity and fueling competition while continuing to drive the next wave of innovation in wireless, broadband and beyond. Headquartered in Bellevue, Wash., T‑Mobile provides services through its subsidiaries and operates its flagship brands, T‑Mobile, Metro by T‑Mobile and Mint Mobile.
